title: IDOL Front Planning Creative Spine
description: Active v17 contract only. Front Planning exact-projects PRE-00 1.8, returns exactly FP-A, FP-B, and FP-C as complete viable routes, hash-binds the selected route full text to the active exact text or a reviewed canonical full-text descendant, authors ordered MJxx Major Stacks, carries one typed/hash-bound connection-quality proof per reference unit, compares two to four Sequence Compositions with non-identical exact Sequence Unit sets per material Major and two to four actual still candidates with non-identical path/SHA-256 identity per material Core Slot, requires one selected exact Core reference or a Founder-authored exact-Core waiver, separates reference coverage from actual Hero generation coverage, and projects the active full-text storyline through one screen_progression_map. Teaser-first production changes only production_scope; it never replaces the complete full-MV planning spine.

sequenceMotionAnalysisBinding.description: Selected-only exact binding to one independently CDD-reviewed Sequence Motion Analysis row. Non-selected candidates cannot carry it. The analysis remains advisory until independent 01 adoption and never scripts 01/02A or final 03V temporal camera truth.

selectedRouteStorylineBinding.description: Hash-bound transport receipt connecting creative_experiment.candidate_route_id to its exact complete_storyline_version and the active canonical storyline. A changed active text is valid only after the selected route text was exact-promoted into one preserved Front Planning revision and the active version is that revision or a later reviewed full-text descendant.

form_logic.description: Why the selected video form serves the song, target, message, and viewing context. It must not invent a narrative-film requirement.

selected_main_reference_ids.description: Use one or more IDs when the Founder supplies and selects a main reference. An empty array is the explicit no-main-reference state and routes discovery function-first through official/original sources. It never authorizes an unselected source or a restricted edit.

referenceFunctionAnalysis.description: A run-owned semantic reading of one exact reference surface. It records only the selected component to combine; it is not a whole-reference recreation, reinterpretation, or standalone semantic cache.

analysis_record.description: For a registered video source, this must be the exact complete source-owned analysis path and SHA-256 from the local video reference analysis registry. The run-owned function, disposition, and binding remain in this row.

connectionQualityProof.description: Typed, hash-bound Reference Connection carry. Validators verify only presence and exact Reference Working Index pointer/hash transport; semantic adequacy remains CDD/Founder review.

source_identity.description: Use the exact registry source_key for a registered video; direct stills and Founder-supplied images retain their own stable source identity.

sequence_unit.description: Required for a sequence_sheet or sequence_direct unit. New v17 writes exactly five hash-bound samples at exact one-second cadence with a contextual flow reading.

wholeFilmSpine.description: Legacy transport name for the complete selected-song video spine. It applies to MV, teaser, performance-led, associative, world/system, object-led, narrative, and hybrid forms and never requires feature-film plot.

reference_function_bindings.description: Bind one governing or primary named reference function. Add support bindings only when another named screen function remains unresolved; no fixed multi-reference blend is required.

reference_unit_ids.description: Applied/combined section-targeted reference units. The section's five-frame sequence bundle id may be cited here to govern Major order/continuity without requiring all five frames to become cuts.

section_story_function.description: Legacy field name for the section's observable content job; narrative plot is optional.

sequence_unit_ids.description: Applied or combined active Sequence Units for this section. Each is exact-five at exact one-second cadence; frame count never determines downstream Cut count.
